markdownRemark.html: Cloud Cuckoo Land is a weird title and I don't really know why I decided to pick it up but I am very glad I did. I am writing this over a year after reading it as I am catching up on writing these. It was a page turner in the best sense of that term. I was drawn in and held until the last moment. A bit too in your face about this idea of the power of books but I really enjoyed the intertwined stories across such disparate characters over great spans of time.
